title: Cancel app-card hover on scroll
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Cancel pending hover reveal when the page or a nested scrolling surface scrolls. Keep deliberate click, tap and key activation, keyboard Run focus and reduced-motion behaviour.

**Related earlier work** · WI-034

**Delivery dependencies** · Can begin on the current PR head. 

**Verify** · Add a regression for pointer entry, partial dwell, scroll and elapsed timer. Verify pointer exit and navigation cancel too. Confirm a fresh hover and explicit activation still work.

**Delivery** · v0.2 client, existing PR #9.
evidence: The capturing window scroll listener stays mounted while a card can dwell, so a page or nested-surface scroll cancels the pending reveal; AppCard tests cover enter -> 500 ms -> scroll with no later reveal, nested surface, pointer exit, fresh hover after scroll and the click/Enter/Escape paths. Live stylus timing was unavailable; recorded as a hardware gap. Evidence: qa/sprint-6/WI-048/.
